灯笼街的一天(A Day at the lantern street): 围绕节日文化的A1短文:介绍杰克的日常、喜好与灯笼街。
We often go to the bookstore together. Jack drinks water every morning. My friend Lily is very kind. The granddaughter helps her grandma cook.
I am happy every day. The lantern street is not far from my home. Lily likes chicken too. The rice is still in the pot.
Jack and Lily are in the same class. I like my life very much. Jack wears a sweater today.
